# Rhombus/HOL

> Rhombus/HOL is an LCF-style higher-order-logic theorem prover embedded in Rhombus, with an ACL2-style automatic prover and an Isabelle/HOL verification of its kernel model.

The complete Markdown manual is generated from the same Scribble sources as the human-readable documentation. Use it for API syntax, logical declarations, termination, proof automation, and trust-boundary details.

## Documentation

- [Complete manual as Markdown](https://tani.github.io/rhombus-hol/llms-full.md): All Rhombus/HOL Scribble documentation combined into one LLM-readable document.
- [Human-readable manual](https://tani.github.io/rhombus-hol/rhombus-hol/index.html): The rendered language and prover manual.

## Formal verification

- [Isabelle/HOL kernel verification](https://tani.github.io/rhombus-hol/isabelle/Unsorted/Rhombus_HOL_Kernel/index.html): Executable-rule adequacy, semantic soundness, extension conservativity, base-model consistency, replay properties, and guard countermodels.

## Optional

- [Licenses and third-party notices](https://tani.github.io/rhombus-hol/licenses/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES): License scope and retained upstream notices.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/tani/rhombus-hol): Rhombus implementation, tests, documentation sources, and Isabelle theories.
